text: 中信建投证券认为，近期市场继续处于9月底以来的第二轮去杠杆过程中，本周A股由此前单边下跌转为高波动震荡，当前市场压力主要来自三个方面：一是中东地缘局势反复油价高位，叠加法国等经济体局部债务风险及美联储后续加息预期，海外流动性偏紧；二是海外三季报好坏参半；三是国内流动性压力尚未完全消化，绝对收益资金的减仓担忧仍在。积极信号在于，10月以来稳市资金已陆续入场。后续底部确认的关键在于稳市资金增量，以及融资资金企稳、ETF承接延续、前期领跌板块对利空不再创新低等信号能否逐步出现。历史经验表明，中期底部形成往往较为波折，保持耐心，等待做多机会。配置上建议防御优先、
text_en: CSC Financial believes that the market has recently remained in the second round of deleveraging since the end of September. This week, A-shares shifted from a previous one-way decline to high-volatility oscillation. Current market pressure comes mainly from three aspects: first, repeated Middle East geopolitical tensions and high oil prices, combined with local debt risks in economies such as France and expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes, have tightened overseas liquidity; second, overseas third-quarter reports were mixed; third, domestic liquidity pressure has not yet been fully absorbed, and concerns about position reductions by absolute-return funds remain. A positive signal is that since October, market-stabilization funds have gradually entered the market. The key to subsequently confirming a bottom lies in whether signals can gradually emerge, including additional market-stabilization funds, stabilization of margin financing funds, continued ETF support, and previously worst-performing sectors no longer hitting new lows on bad news. Historical experience shows that mid-term bottoms tend to form in a bumpy process; stay patient and wait for opportunities to go long.
